Estimated volume is 7 × 3 × 1.5 cm, or about 30 cm³ across the stacked slices. At roughly 1.05 g/cm³ that is about 35-50 g. I'll take about 55 g to allow for the sauce.

Cooked beef is about 200 kcal per 100 g, so 55 g comes to about 110 kcal. Allowing a little extra for the sauce, I'll say 120 kcal.
